World Scientific prints 'The following sections are included:' plus the section titles under its 'Abstract:' heading for every chapter or matter item that has no abstract; it names the item's sections and says nothing about content, the charter § 6 rule of 24 Oct 14:17 (templated stand-ins, like CABI's 'This datasheet on <taxon> covers <sections>.'). In #2145's 550-page World Scientific sample 109 page texts start this way, all on chapters, front or back matter and proceedings volumes with no abstract of their own.
